operations: Identify all spiral galaxies in table
Extract apparent magnitudes for spiral galaxies
Compare with magnitudes of other object types
Check if spiral galaxies have smallest magnitude values
reviews.reason: Two spiral galaxies exist: NGC 5457 (magnitude 8.7) and NGC 5474 (magnitude 11.9). Other objects: irregular galaxy NGC 5408 (14.0), globular cluster NGC 5466 (10.5), irregular galaxy NGC 5477 (14.5). The smallest magnitude is 8.7 (NGC 5457, spiral galaxy), but statement claims ALL spiral galaxies have the least magnitude. NGC 5474 (11.9) does NOT have the least magnitude since NGC 5466 (10.5) has smaller magnitude. Therefore 'spiral galaxy have the least apparent magnitude' is false.
